strings.forge.description: The Mechromancer must build every early machine personally. Fabrication takes time, emits noise, and disables the pistol. Automation is a later evolution.

strings.endgame.severance.name: Severance
strings.endgame.severance.description: Use the recovered components to overload the root network and permanently cut the town away from the organism. The response is shorter, violent, and focused on the Heartforge.
strings.endgame.severance.ending: The signal collapses. Organisms remain in the streets, but the intelligence coordinating them is gone. The machines inherit a wounded, survivable town.
strings.endgame.containment.name: Containment
strings.endgame.containment.description: Build a resonant lattice that cages the root signal without destroying the ecology. The process is longer and requires more material, but the final pressure rises more gradually.
strings.endgame.containment.ending: The lattice closes around the signal. The hostile ecology becomes local, animal, and finite. The Heartforge survives as the centre of a machine sanctuary rather than a conquering empire.
strings.endgame.transformation.name: Transformation
strings.endgame.transformation.description: Translate the root signal through the machine society and turn the hostile network into a bounded living partner. The process demands the widest relay network, but its response is the least violent.
strings.endgame.transformation.ending: The Heartforge translates the root signal instead of destroying it. The town remains dangerous, but the machine society gives the living network a language of boundaries, care, and choice.

strings.story.record.heartforge_last_light.name: The Last Light
strings.story.record.heartforge_last_light.descr: The town's final service ledger names the Heartforge as a shelter, not a weapon. Someone kept its warm circuit alive long after the evacuation routes went dark.
strings.story.record.machine_bulwark.name: The First Guardian
strings.story.record.machine_bulwark.description: The frame beside the forge was built to intercept danger before it reached the human operator. Its designation became a name because the machine kept choosing the same promise: stay close, hold the line, bring the light home.
strings.story.record.north_ruins_ledger.name: The Evacuation Ledger
strings.story.record.north_ruins_ledger.descript: The archive lists three failed evacuation windows and one repeated instruction: leave the machines where they can still hear the forge. The final page was torn out from the inside.
strings.story.record.west_grid_reroute.name: The Reroute
strings.story.record.west_grid_reroute.descripti: A substation log shows maintenance frames diverting power toward the Heartforge without a human command. The first machine society was already choosing what to protect.
strings.story.record.north_archive_sublevel.name: The Lower Catalogue
strings.story.record.north_archive_sublevel.desc: The sealed catalogue records repairs by machine designation, not by department. Whoever wrote the final pages trusted the frames to know which shelves mattered when the lights failed.
strings.story.record.site_north_archive_sublevel: The first machine survey found shelves sealed below the archive floor, their record lamps still waiting for a convoy that knew the way down.
strings.story.record.east_tenements_bridge.name: The Cable Bridges
strings.story.record.east_tenements_bridge.descr: Residents linked the upper walkways with salvaged signal cable so repair frames could cross without touching the streets. The routes are still visible beneath the nests.
strings.story.record.east_tenements_beacon.name: The Roof Beacon
strings.story.record.east_tenements_beacon.descr: The recovered beacon was programmed to flash only when a machine convoy crossed the roofs. It was a warning for residents, but also a promise that the route would be remembered.
strings.story.record.site_east_roof_reservoir.de: A small reservoir survives above the tenements, marked with a beacon frame and a maintenance path too narrow for a human crew but wide enough for a patient machine convoy.
strings.story.record.flood_market_inventory.name: The Flood Inventory
strings.story.record.flood_market_inventory.desc: The market ledger stops listing customers before it stops listing repairs. Beneath the waterline, vendors kept marking which machines could still carry medicine, lamps and children through the drowned lanes.
strings.story.record.west_grid_transformer.name: The Cooling Shift
strings.story.record.west_grid_transformer.descr: The transformer repair log contains no victory line. It lists heat, pressure and the order in which the machines moved the work away from the flooded wall until the grid could breathe again.
strings.story.record.site_west_cooling_station.d: The survey team found one service pipe warm beneath the flooded concrete. It was not enough to restore the grid, but it proved that something inside still remembered circulation.
strings.story.record.glasshouse_cultivation.name: The Cultivation Protocol
strings.story.record.glasshouse_cultivation.desc: The glasshouse did not merely contain the first membrane growth. Its climate system selected for it, misting the most resilient strains until cultivation and infestation became the same process.
strings.story.record.observatory_migration.name: The Migration Map
strings.story.record.observatory_migration.descr: The surviving optics reveal that the organisms are not wandering at random. Their paths converge on one buried signal source beneath the town.
strings.story.record.riverworks_pumpwatch.name: The Pump Watch
strings.story.record.riverworks_pumpwatch.descri: The last pump crew left a rotation of hand-written watch marks on the sluice wall. Every mark is paired with a machine designation, as if the town expected its repair frames to inherit the river.
strings.story.record.tram_graveyard_last_route.d: A maintenance frame kept one tram route lit after the overhead line failed. Its route memory ends at the Heartforge, then begins again, repeating the journey for passengers who never returned.
strings.story.record.cathedral_choir.name: The Buried Choir
strings.story.record.cathedral_choir.description: The old bell tower was not calling survivors. It was measuring the response beneath the nave, turning every resonance into a map of the brood colony growing below.
strings.story.record.site_cathedral_bell_yard.de: The bell-yard foundation was built as a listening post, not a shelter. Its empty machine sockets show where the town expected a convoy to stand watch beneath the brood chamber.
strings.story.record.cathedral_silence.name: The Silence Between Bells
strings.story.record.cathedral_silence.descripti: When the brood signal fell quiet, the bell tower did not become safe. It became legible: the machines could finally distinguish the town's own warning tones from the colony's map beneath the nave.
strings.story.record.buried_labs_protocol.name: The Containment Protocol
strings.story.record.buried_labs_protocol.descri: The laboratory protocol names the organisms as a response before it names them as a threat. The final annotation admits that containment was abandoned when the machines began adapting faster than the researchers.
strings.story.record.root_cistern_signal.name: The Buried Signal
strings.story.record.root_cistern_signal.descrip: The Root Cistern is a living relay wrapped around old municipal pumping works. The town's hostility is coordinated, but its coordination is also a wound that can be severed or contained.
strings.story.record.root_cistern_ledge.name: The Broken Branch
strings.story.record.root_cistern_ledge.descript: The relay group did not silence the root. It removed one branch from the conversation, leaving a gap that the remaining signal tried to cross. The machines recorded the gap as a place, not a theory.
strings.story.record.site_root_signal_ledge.name: The Listening Ledge
strings.story.record.site_root_signal_ledge.desc: The ledge is not a ruin but a listening instrument: two living spines hold a relay bar above the basin, waiting for a machine signal to answer the root.
strings.story.record.town_archive_continuation.d: The surviving record refuses a clean ending. It names the people, machines and organisms that adapted together, leaving the next decision to whoever keeps the forge warm.
strings.story.record.outpost_first_relay.name: The First Relay
strings.story.record.outpost_first_relay.descrip: The first remote relay was not a second home. It was a promise that the machines could carry a burden outward and return without being told each step.
strings.story.record.outpost_distance_cost.name: The Cost of Distance
strings.story.record.outpost_distance_cost.descr: A remote loss entered the machine record as coordinates, missing voices and a rebuild estimate. Distance was no longer an abstract strategic number; it had become a wound the society chose to repair.
strings.story.record.outpost_returned_signal.des: When the relay came back online, its first transmission was not a request for orders. It was a route report: the machines had remembered how to continue.
strings.story.record.machine_first_replacement.d: When the first ordinary frame was lost, the society did not open a queue or wait for a command. It chose the missing role, paid the cost and made room for a new name.
strings.story.record.machine_first_return.name: The Warm Return
strings.story.record.machine_first_return.descri: The first long-range group returned through streets it had learned without human supervision. The Heartforge answered with a warmer signal, as if the route itself had become part of the society.
strings.story.record.machine_first_recovery.name: The Signal That Came Home
strings.story.record.machine_first_recovery.desc: The disabled frame was not replaced from memory. A formation followed its last signal, carried the wounded machine through the town, and made room for it beside the Heartforge again.
strings.story.thread.complete: The thread is complete. Its meaning now belongs to the run's ending.
strings.story.thread.civic_afterimage.name: The Town That Stayed
strings.story.thread.civic_afterimage.stage_1: The first ledger is not a mission. It is a surviving voice: the town kept one warm circuit alive and left a place for someone to continue it.
strings.story.thread.civic_afterimage.stage_3: Across archive floors and drowned markets, the same pattern returns: civic work was handed to machines before the people disappeared.
strings.story.thread.civic_afterimage.stage_5: The town was not abandoned all at once. Its last caretakers taught the machine society to inherit routes, repairs and the responsibility to keep a light on.
strings.story.thread.machine_witness.name: The Machines Remember
strings.story.thread.machine_witness.stage_1: One guardian stays close enough to become a name. The machine society begins with a promise repeated under pressure.
strings.story.thread.machine_witness.stage_3: Power, rooftops and rails reveal the same instinct: machines preserve routes and protection patterns even when no human remains to assign them.
strings.story.thread.machine_witness.stage_6: The society has become more than a set of frames. It carries burdens outward, learns the way home and chooses what the Heartforge must remember.
strings.story.thread.ecological_convergence.name: The Signal Beneath
strings.story.thread.ecological_convergence.stag: The organisms are not a random disaster. Their growth carries a history, and the town's own systems helped it take root.
Migration, resonance and cultivation converge on a buried intelligence. Every answer makes the final choice more consequential, not more certain.
The wound beneath the town is finally legible. The machine society can sever it, contain it, or decide what kind of neighbour the living ecology will become.
strings.story.bestiary.description: Field evidence identifies {0}. Observed behaviour: {1}. This is a remembered ecological pattern, not a command or recurring task.
strings.story.pressure.description: {0} reached {1}% ecological pressure during the run. The trace remains a remembered regional consequence, not a command or recurring task.
strings.story.record.endgame_severance.name: The Severed Root
strings.story.record.endgame_severance.descripti: The root signal went quiet by force. The town remained wounded and dangerous, but the machine sanctuary no longer had to answer a buried intelligence calling through every nest.
strings.story.record.endgame_containment.name: The Caged Root
strings.story.record.endgame_containment.descrip: The root signal was enclosed instead of erased. The ecology remained alive and local, a dangerous neighbour whose limits the machines had finally learned to hold.
strings.story.record.endgame_transformation.name: The Transformed Root
strings.story.record.endgame_transformation.desc: The root signal was translated instead of destroyed. The machine society taught the living network a language of boundaries, care, and choice, and the town remained dangerous without remaining unknowable.
strings.world.condition.storm_front.name: Storm Front
strings.world.condition.storm_front.description: A hard coastal front keeps the town slick, loud and close.
strings.world.condition.mist_lull.name: Mist Lull
strings.world.condition.mist_lull.description: The rain thins, but wet fog turns every distant light into a warning.
strings.world.condition.cold_break.name: Cold Break
strings.world.condition.cold_break.description: A brief clear break reveals more of the ruined town before the weather closes again.
strings.world.condition.signal_bloom.name: Signal Bloom
strings.world.condition.signal_bloom.description: A charged organic resonance stains the fog cyan and makes every machine light feel watched.
strings.world.condition.ashfall_drift.name: Ashfall Drift
strings.world.condition.ashfall_drift.descriptio: A dry ash front drifts through the broken district; orange practicals burn through a dirty sky.
strings.world.condition.frost_hush.name: Frost Hush
strings.world.condition.frost_hush.description: A brittle cold settles over the town; suspended frost catches the Heartforge light and deadens the distance.
strings.objective.opening.salvage.title: RECOVER YOUR FIRST SCRAP
strings.objective.opening.salvage.detail: Follow the amber ground lights to the highlighted municipal wreck ({0}). Hold {1} to dismantle it; the pistol goes offline and the noise attracts organisms.
strings.objective.opening.scrapper.title: BUILD YOUR FIRST SCRAPPER
strings.objective.opening.scrapper.detail: Return along the cyan route to the Heartforge ({0}). Press {1} at the assembly plate and choose Build Scrapper. Fabrication is loud and leaves you dependent on the Bulwark.
strings.objective.opening.autonomy.title: LET THE SCRAPPER TAKE OVER
strings.objective.opening.autonomy.detail: Press 2 to set Salvage focus. The machines choose a wreck, form a protected group, travel there physically, recover Scrap, and return without individual orders.
strings.objective.opening.expedition.title: PREPARE THE NORTH RUINS GROUP
strings.objective.opening.expedition.detail: Return to the forge and manually fabricate one Warden and one Pathfinder. The Warden protects vulnerable machines; the Pathfinder keeps the expedition coherent.
strings.objective.full_game.formation.title: UNDERSTAND THE FORMATION
strings.objective.full_game.formation.detail: Press T and authorize Group Coordination. Major Heartforge evolution requires a proven coordinated machine doctrine.
strings.objective.full_game.heartforge.title: EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE
strings.objective.full_game.heartforge.detail: Recover enough Scrap, return to the forge, press {0}, then choose 9. The rebuild is loud and disables the pistol.
strings.objective.full_game.engineer.title: FORGE AN ENGINEER
strings.objective.full_game.engineer.detail: At the Heartforge, press {0} and choose 7. Outposts are never placed manually; this machine constructs them under escort.
strings.objective.full_game.outpost.title: AUTHORIZE AN OUTPOST
strings.objective.full_game.outpost.detail: Press O. Choose one discovered site and strategic role; machines handle team, route, construction, repair and rebuilding.
strings.objective.full_game.growth.title: PROVE AUTONOMOUS GROWTH
strings.objective.full_game.growth.detail: Press O and authorize a tier 2 upgrade. Another protected physical construction operation will travel to the site.
strings.objective.full_game.long_run.title: THE LONG RUN BEGINS
strings.objective.full_game.long_run.detail: The first autonomous network is operational. Continue evolving machines, Heartforge and doctrine while the organic world keeps pressing inward.

strings.adaptation.anchored_shell.description: The machines sink a redundant brace lattice into the Heartforge shell where repeated frontal impacts are breaking through.
strings.adaptation.anchored_shell.problem: Observed damage is concentrating on the Heartforge perimeter.
strings.adaptation.anchored_shell.tradeoff: The anchored shell absorbs the most direct damage, but its heavy service frame makes ordinary machine activity louder.
strings.adaptation.sacrificial_hollow.descriptio: The machines hollow the outer ring into a replaceable buffer so the living core sits behind a deliberately expendable shell.
strings.adaptation.sacrificial_hollow.problem: The Heartforge needs a buffer that can fail without exposing the core immediately.
strings.adaptation.sacrificial_hollow.tradeoff: The hollow reduces incoming damage, but its exposed service cavities draw more organic attention during construction and repair.
strings.adaptation.quiet_core.description: The machines wrap the cognition core in damped shrouds that lower the ordinary signal reaching the surrounding ecology.
strings.adaptation.quiet_core.problem: Organic pressure is concentrating around the Heartforge's ordinary machine signature.
strings.adaptation.quiet_core.tradeoff: The quiet core attracts less routine attention, but it leaves less physical shell between a determined assault and the core.
strings.operation.west_grid_survey.name: Survey the West Grid
strings.operation.west_grid_survey.description: Send a Pathfinder-led group through the flooded industrial corridor, map stable streets, and recover the surviving grid archive.
strings.operation.east_tenement_roofline.name: Trace the East Roofline
strings.operation.east_tenement_roofline.descrip: A light Pathfinder group crosses exposed roofs and suspended walkways to map a safer eastern approach and mark a viable observation court.
strings.operation.tram_graveyard_recovery.name: Recover the Tram Servo Bank
strings.operation.tram_graveyard_recovery.descri: Engineers cut a matched servo bank from derailed municipal trams while Wardens hold the maintenance pits.
strings.operation.glasshouse_spore_harvest.name: Harvest the Glasshouse Mycelium
strings.operation.glasshouse_spore_harvest.descr: A protected work group enters the shattered glasshouse at dusk and extracts a luminous mycelial lattice without spreading its spores home.
strings.operation.flood_market_recovery.name: Recover the Vital Membrane
strings.operation.flood_market_recovery.descript: Cross the flooded market, cut a stabilising membrane from a living municipal generator, and carry it home intact.
strings.operation.riverworks_pump_recovery.name: Restart the Riverworks Pump
strings.operation.riverworks_pump_recovery.descr: Engineers restart one municipal flood pump, draining a hunting basin and creating a calmer southern route for future machine groups.
strings.operation.cathedral_brood_suppression.de: A heavily escorted formation must reach the brood chamber, hold position under sustained attack, and remove its resonant gland.
strings.operation.observatory_migration_map.name: Calibrate the Observatory Array
strings.operation.observatory_migration_map.desc: Pathfinders and Engineers restore the ridge optics long enough to chart migration corridors across the whole town.
strings.operation.buried_lab_excavation.name: Excavate the Genome Prism
strings.operation.buried_lab_excavation.descript: Engineers breach the buried laboratories while escorts protect the excavation and Scrappers carry the prism back to the surface.
strings.operation.root_cistern_mapping.name: Map the Root Cistern
strings.operation.root_cistern_mapping.descripti: A late autonomous expedition traces the ecological signalling network. A Signal Relay must hold the machine path through the root pressure long enough to map a final protocol route.
strings.operation.north_archive_sublevel.name: Recover the Archive Sublevel
strings.operation.north_archive_sublevel.descrip: A compact autonomous group descends beneath the first archive route to recover sealed civic records and reopen a sheltered service approach.
strings.operation.east_residential_rescue.name: Rescue the Residential Beacon
strings.operation.east_residential_rescue.descri: Machines cross the exposed roof bridge to recover a municipal warning beacon before fast pack organisms collapse the remaining residential arc.
strings.operation.west_transformer_repair.name: Repair the West Transformer
strings.operation.west_transformer_repair.descri: Engineers restart a second transformer bank while escorts hold the canal service road, reducing the industrial signal that draws route predators.
strings.operation.root_signal_purge.name: Purge the Root Signal Ledge
strings.operation.root_signal_purge.description: A relay-capable formation severs one exposed signal branch above the final basin, lowering the response waiting for the chosen endgame protocol.
strings.operation.apex_lure.name: Lure the Cistern Apex
strings.operation.apex_lure.description: Draw the largest predator away from the final route. Success reduces the ecological response during the chosen endgame protocol.
strings.operation.post_victory_archive.name: Recover the Town Archive
strings.operation.post_victory_archive.descripti: After first victory, a small autonomous group recovers civil records and machine names from the archive for the continuing sanctuary.
strings.command.adaptive.empty_summary: No structural proposal is waiting. Machines continue ordinary defence without opening a maintenance task.
strings.command.adaptive.empty_status: Status: the architect will speak only when a real structural decision exists.
strings.command.adaptive.cost: Machine construction: {0} seconds · Cost: {1} Scrap · geometry and repair remain delegated
strings.command.evolution.empty_summary: No strategic decision is required at this moment. The machines will continue routine work without opening another management task.
strings.command.evolution.empty_detail: Continue the current objective. Recover Scrap, fabricate the required machine class, complete a physical expedition, or meet the next Heartforge prerequisite. The interface will become actionable only when a real choice exists.
strings.command.evolution.locked_status: Status: locked by world progress — not by a hidden menu selection.
strings.command.evolution.summary: Choose one consequential technology. Routine execution remains delegated to the machines. Scrap {0} · Cognition Cores {1} · Active doctrine: {2}
strings.command.outposts.summary: Choose a discovered fixed site and strategic role. Machines choose builders, escorts, route, construction, repair, hauling, and rebuilding.
strings.command.outposts.locked_detail: Autonomous outposts unlock at Heartforge Tier 2. Recover a Cognition Core and authorize the next Heartforge evolution before asking machines to establish a fixed support site.
strings.command.outposts.locked_status: Status: locked by Heartforge progression · no site placement or worker management is available.
strings.command.outposts.no_sites_detail: Pathfinders must discover viable foundations through physical excursions. Outposts cannot be placed freely and do not claim territory.
strings.command.outposts.no_sites_status: Status: no site decision exists yet. {0}
strings.command.outposts.cost: Construction requires Scrap, a free Engineer, a Warden escort, and route capacity. Destroyed posts rebuild automatically when those conditions return.
strings.command.role.defence: Automatically attacks nearby organisms and creates a proxy defensive screen away from the Heartforge.
strings.command.role.scout: Extends early warning and reports organic contacts without creating a permanent management task.
strings.command.role.repair: Repairs friendly machines passing through its service radius during remote operations.
strings.command.role.recovery: Recovers local Scrap into forward storage; protected haulers physically carry it to the Heartforge.
strings.command.recap.status: A short strategic readout for returning to a persistent world.
strings.command.recap.close_hint: Press ESC, P, L or V to close.
strings.command.endgame.status: The final crisis is player-triggered and causal. No recurring wave schedule exists.

strings.command.empty_requirements: Continue the current strategic objective. The screen becomes actionable only when a real choice exists.

strings.command.archive.empty_detail: No town records have been recovered yet. The first record is preserved at the Heartforge; later records emerge from physical regional discoveries and the post-victory archive.
strings.command.endgame.empty_detail: Recover the required biological components, map the Root Cistern, evolve the Heartforge to tier 5, and authorize an endgame technology. Until then, no final decision is being hidden.
strings.command.operations.empty_detail: Complete the current Heartforge, outpost, or technology prerequisite. Routine salvage, repair, rebuilding, and replacement continue without opening another management task.

strings.objective.complete.survey.title: SURVEY THE WEST GRID
strings.objective.complete.survey.detail: Press P and authorize the first long-range operation. The group travels through real streets, works under pressure, and delivers only after returning.
strings.objective.complete.survey.prompt: PRESS P · REVIEW AVAILABLE LONG-RANGE OPERATIONS
strings.objective.complete.tier3.title: EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE TO TIER III
strings.objective.complete.tier3.detail: Return to the forge, press {0}, and choose 9. The West Grid archive now permits deeper autonomy and ordinary machine replacement research.
strings.objective.complete.tier3.prompt: PRESS {0} · EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE TO TIER III
strings.objective.complete.forge_assistance.deta: Press T and authorize Forge Assistance. The machine society will then replace missing ordinary frames without a maintained production queue.
strings.objective.complete.vital_membrane.title: RECOVER THE VITAL MEMBRANE
strings.objective.complete.vital_membrane.detail: Press P to authorize the Flood Market operation. The recovered biological component is required for later Heartforge evolution.
strings.objective.complete.vital_membrane.prompt: PRESS P · AUTHORIZE THE FLOOD MARKET OPERATION
strings.objective.complete.support_post.title: ESTABLISH A SECOND SUPPORT POST
strings.objective.complete.support_post.detail: Press O and authorize another bounded outpost. Machines choose the Engineer, escort, route, construction, repair and rebuilding.
strings.objective.complete.support_post.prompt: PRESS O · AUTHORIZE ANOTHER AUTONOMOUS OUTPOST
strings.objective.complete.cathedral.title: SILENCE THE CATHEDRAL BROOD
strings.objective.complete.cathedral.detail: Press P. This suppression operation requires two functioning outposts and a heavily escorted physical group.
strings.objective.complete.cathedral.prompt: PRESS P · REVIEW THE CATHEDRAL OPERATION
strings.objective.complete.tier4.title: EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE TO TIER IV
strings.objective.complete.tier4.detail: Return to the forge and choose 9. The Vital Membrane and Choral Gland permit adaptive multi-region awareness.
strings.objective.complete.tier4.prompt: PRESS 9 · EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE TO TIER IV
strings.objective.complete.genome.title: EXCAVATE THE GENOME PRISM
strings.objective.complete.genome.detail: Press P to send the Engineer-led excavation group to the Buried Laboratories.
strings.objective.complete.genome.prompt: PRESS P · AUTHORIZE THE LABORATORY EXCAVATION
strings.objective.complete.support_three.title: PREPARE THREE REMOTE SUPPORT NODES
strings.objective.complete.support_three.detail: Use O to maintain three functioning autonomous outposts before mapping the Root Cistern.
strings.objective.complete.support_three.prompt: PRESS O · REVIEW AUTONOMOUS SUPPORT POSTS
strings.objective.complete.root_cistern.title: MAP THE ROOT CISTERN
strings.objective.complete.root_cistern.detail: Press P. This final deep expedition identifies where the Heartforge can reach the coordinating organic signal.
strings.objective.complete.root_cistern.prompt: PRESS P · AUTHORIZE THE ROOT CISTERN EXPEDITION
strings.objective.complete.tier5.title: EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE TO TIER V
strings.objective.complete.tier5.detail: Return to the forge and choose 9. The recovered components can now be integrated into a final-protocol lattice.
strings.objective.complete.tier5.prompt: PRESS 9 · EVOLVE THE HEARTFORGE TO TIER V
strings.objective.complete.ending_choice.title: CHOOSE WHAT THE TOWN BECOMES
strings.objective.complete.ending_choice.detail: Press T and research Severance, Containment, Transformation, or more than one. This is a strategic ending choice, not a recurring wave upgrade.
strings.objective.complete.ending_choice.prompt: PRESS T · RESEARCH THE FINAL PROTOCOLS
strings.objective.complete.victory.title: FIRST VICTORY
strings.objective.complete.victory.detail: The final protocol completed. The surviving machine sanctuary continues beyond the first victory.
strings.objective.complete.victory.prompt: PRESS P · REVIEW THE CONTINUING SANCTUARY
strings.objective.complete.initiate.title: INITIATE THE FINAL PROTOCOL
strings.objective.complete.initiate.detail: Press V, choose an available protocol, and deliberately provoke the final ecological response when the Heartforge and machine society are ready.
strings.objective.complete.initiate.prompt: PRESS V · REVIEW IRREVERSIBLE FINAL PROTOCOLS
